name: Repo Audit
tagline: Technical repository audit and architecture review — sellable engineering vertical

product.name: Repo Audit
product.description: GitHub repository analysis, architecture review, and remediation roadmap for client engineering engagements.

presets.taskTemplate: Audit GitHub repo {{repoUrl}} — architecture, code quality, security hotspots, and prioritized remediation roadmap.
presets.deliverableHint: ADR + audit report in docs/cto/ and docs/fullstack/ with executive summary for client delivery.

presets.taskTemplate: Weekly review for active repo-audit engagements — open findings, client follow-ups, and billable status.
presets.deliverableHint: Ops checklist in docs/operations/ with owners and due dates.

presets.taskTemplate: If the repo ships a public docs site or landing — audit SEO discoverability and technical SEO blockers.
presets.deliverableHint: SEO audit in docs/research/ with copy-ready fixes.

profileSeed.summary: Repo Audit — sell technical due diligence and architecture reviews as fixed-fee encargos.
profileSeed.valueProposition: Structured multi-agent repo analysis with deliverables clients can forward to their board.
profileSeed.targetAudience: PE firms, acquirers, CTOs evaluating acquisitions, and teams before major refactors.
profileSeed.problemStatement: Ad-hoc code reviews miss architecture, ops, and quality dimensions; consultants lack repeatable agent playbooks.
profileSeed.businessModel: Fixed audit ($2k–$10k) by repo size; rush tier +50%.
profileSeed.monetizationHypothesis: First audit → retainer for remediation sprints via feature-development preset.
profileSeed.nextAction: Commission repo-analysis from Ingeniería with a GitHub URL, deliver via encargo link, record revenue.

defaultNextAction: Apply Repo Audit pack — run repo-analysis service from Office with a public GitHub URL.
